[attribute-language-version]
=== `@language-version` Code Language Version

Version of the language in which this code is written, e.g., “`3.0`”, for code written in “Javascript 3.0”. (The “javascript” should be recorded in the <<attribute-language,`@language`>> attribute.)

#### OPTIONAL on elements:  <<element-code,`<code>`>>, 
                  <<element-inline-code,`<inline-code>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The version of the language in the code sample, such as
                        “`3.0`”, “`8A`”, 
                        etc.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
